quarterly_data.signal: EVX-01 Phase 2 (advanced melanoma) three-year immune data, to be presented as an ESMO 2026 poster on October 24, 2026: EVX-01 induced an immune response in all patients, with 89% of its personalised vaccine neoantigen targets inducing a tumor-specific T-cell response (86% at the two-year follow-up), and T-cell responses were sustained in magnitude and breadth during the third year of EVX-01 monotherapy. CSO and COO Birgitte Ronoe: the 89% target precision is 'another confirmation that AI-Immunology identifies and selects the most therapeutically relevant vaccine targets.' Evaxion says its cash runway extends well into the second half of 2027.
